summary: Tested per-format leaderboard feature end-to-end. Backend format query param on /api/stats/leaderboard and /api/exports/leaderboard.csv works correctly; filtered wins+losses match participation count per format. Frontend pill buttons (all/1v1/2v2/3v3) re-query the API and update the table; csvHref correctly includes &format=<f> for non-All and omits it for All. The feature itself is correct — verified using a fresh seeded TEST_UI season which produced the expected per-format MMR/W-L differences. Main agent may want to investigate seed hygiene or add orphaned-match cleanup.
